A [[Diamond]] is a rare crafting material introduced in [[Nightfall]].  They are one of the required materials needed to craft [[Destroyer weapons]], which are crafted by [[Balthor Coalforge]] in the [[Slavers' Exile]] dungeon.

==Acquisition==
* [[Expert Salvage Kit|Expert salvaged]] from [[:Category:Contains diamond|certain items]] (rare chance).
* No [[creature]]s currently appear to [[drop]] [[:Category:Drops diamond|Diamonds]].  
*[[Core]]
** Purchased from [[rare material trader]]s
** Always [[drop]]s from the [[Underworld Chest]]. Possible drop from the [[Chest of Woe]].
*[[Factions]]
** As a quest reward from [[Free Birds]], [[Free Birds (Hard mode)]], and [[Honorable Combat (Hard mode)]]
* [[Nightfall]]
** Traded from [[Vabbi Trade Official]]s for 7 [[Trade Contract]]s
** Possible drop from [[Treasure]]s
** 5 Diamonds are a random reward from a [[Coffer of Whispers]]
* [[Eye of the North]]
** [[Dungeon]] [[chest]] [[reward]]s
** Possible drop from [[Hidden Treasure]]s revealed with [[Light of Deldrimor]]
** As a quest reward from [[Attack on Jalis's Camp]]

==Trivia==
*Diamond, [[Onyx Gemstone]], and [[Spiritwood Plank]] are the only [[crafting material]]s that cannot be used to craft [[armor]].
*Although diamonds were introduced in Nightfall, it was not until Eye of the North that they had a purpose. This created a lot of speculation in online forums during 2006-2007.
